summary.text: Heaven Envies Heroic Geniuses is a killer move Fang Yuan activates using heaven's envy Immortal Gu as the core, targeting people with outstanding talents.

claims.text: Black lightning keeps striking Nie Kuang Feng while Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, caught in the same suction, is not hit. Blood dragons and grey spirits also close on Nie Kuang Feng. Other Gu Immortals take tribulations, but Nie Kuang Feng draws the most animosity. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch sees rock monkey Bu Tian Kong under the same pressure, disrupted by bats and white flying cranes while Solid Rock Warrior and the rest are less targeted.

From Book Mountain, Qin Ding Ling finds tribulations in Savage Wilderness Great World low in strength and quantity, Green Lotus Great World ordinary, and Yellow Earth Great World abnormal: more severe, and aimed at Nie Kuang Feng and Bu Tian Kong. Fairy Yu Xiu’s deduction names this as Fang Yuan’s work. The mysterious killer move can amplify calamities and tribulations of heaven and earth, prioritizing those with the most outstanding aptitude and talent. Nie Kuang Feng and Bu Tian Kong represent the small worlds and Green Lotus Great World, two of those with the greatest innate luck among the inhabitants of Crazed Demon Cave’s eighth layer, so they are targeted specifically.

The killer move’s range increases rapidly and reaches Book Mountain. Tribulation clouds cover over ten thousand li. The tribulation targets Fairy Feng Ya, who possesses talent Gu and is in closed cultivation to deduce Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangement. Wisdom path deductions expose the user, so heaven and earth start a tribulation to exterminate her. Qin Ding Ling takes this as Fang Yuan using Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangement to attack Heavenly Court, and wants to bring Divine Emperor City to the front lines. Fairy Yu Xiu refuses: that is what Fang Yuan wants. The key is to protect Fairy Feng Ya.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun senses the method, praises that it contains heaven path profundity, and finds it out of his expectations that Fang Yuan seems to be cultivating heaven path. Desolate Extremity Jiao Huo is displeased that Fang Yuan uses the move on Savage Wilderness Great World as well. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun says that when they made the alliance agreement Fang Yuan had already considered this, used the loophole, and is not breaking the alliance, because the move is mainly targeting Duan Hu. Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace then takes action. Fang Yuan sees luck path aura mix into the operations of the worlds, combining with Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangements to hasten the fusion of the small worlds, and also the method of all living beings luck. Longevity Heaven’s subordinate mutant Gu Immortals face less pressure from the tribulations.

Fang Yuan originally wanted to use this move on venerables. Unleashed at this timing, it complements Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangements and uses his power to spread across the various great worlds, amplifying its strength.

Fang Yuan’s four rank eight subordinates encircle Bu Tian Kong and tell each other to make use of their master’s method, letting the tribulations wear it down. All along this killer move has been exerting its effect. The tribulations are used to target Bu Tian Kong, Nie Kuang Feng, and the rest. Most of the tribulations are a refinement path method to refine the various small worlds and the conflicting dao marks between the great worlds. Even though this killer move can restrain Nie Kuang Feng, it cannot kill him. Nie Kuang Feng has Heavenly Court’s help and recovers quickly.

Fang Yuan deduced and modified many killer moves, including this one, Dang Hun Luo Po Seal, road of life, several hundred totem killer moves, and countless compound killer moves. Most of them were used in Crazed Demon Cave.

Fang Yuan had his own heaven path accumulation before looting Paradise Earth: rank eight heavenly secret Gu, heaven’s envy Gu, and this killer move that he used in Crazed Demon Cave, as well as heaven form that he was saving then.
